headlines.headline: PORTAL RESHUFFLES BLUEBLOODS AS DRAFT DECISIONS FIRM UP
headlines.detail: Iowa State sharpshooter Milan Momcilovic (48.7% from three, 16.9 ppg) withdrew from the NBA Draft and committed to Kentucky, while Wake Forest's Juke Harris (21.4 ppg) picked Tennessee and 7-2 center Moustapha Thiam chose Michigan. Kansas's Jalen Bidunga declared for the June 25 draft while keeping eligibility.

headlines.headline: KNICKS WIN FIRST TITLE SINCE 1973; DRAFT LOOMS JUNE 23
headlines.detail: The New York Knicks closed out Victor Wembanyama and the Spurs 94-90 in Game 5 to win the Finals 4-1, capping a 13-game postseason run and earning Jalen Brunson Finals MVP. Attention turns to the 2026 NBA Draft, which opens June 23.

headlines.headline: MINICAMPS WIND DOWN WITH QB HEALTH IN FOCUS
headlines.detail: Falcons QB Michael Penix Jr. (knee) remained limited and not cleared for 11-on-11 work, while Titans rookie Cam Ward said his surgically repaired throwing shoulder is fine. Eight teams, including the Cowboys and Falcons, wrap mandatory minicamp June 18 before summer break.

headlines.headline: TRANSFER PORTAL CLASSES SET AS QUIET PERIOD BEGINS
headlines.detail: With the portal effectively closed, Penn State's new staff imported nearly 40 transfers led by QB Rocco Becht, Texas Tech landed top dual-threat QB Brendan Sorsby, and LSU built the No. 1-ranked class under Lane Kiffin. Coaches opened direct contact with 2028 recruits on June 15.
